items.message:
Yessica was truly one of the pillars that made my Software Engineering Boot Camp experience at Coding Temple both memorable and transformative. It's rare to encounter an instructor whose dedication, empathy, and expertise stand out amid a fast-paced program, but from day one, Yessica made a real impact.

Her approach went beyond just teaching the curriculum. Yessica invested herself in my success and that of every student she worked with. She graded my assignments with thorough, actionable feedback, never settling for cursory remarks. Instead, she pointed out strengths and areas for improvement, always giving clear, practical next steps. This made learning meaningful and empowered me to see mistakes as chances to grow.

What truly set Yessica apart was her proactive support. She didn't just respond to problems; she anticipated them. For example, when I posted about a free tool (Perplexity AI) to help my peers, some classmates were confused. Rather than letting confusion linger, Yessica reached out directly to clarify and suggest alternatives. Her initiative helped create a supportive learning environment where no one felt isolated.

Yessica became a reliable resource to bounce ideas off, always encouraging open dialogue and innovation. She has an exceptional ability to see where we need to improve, and where our strengths can help others. Several project milestones were achieved because of her insight, whether debugging code, understanding frameworks, or managing the emotional side of learning new material.

She embodies a genuinely collaborative spirit, treating learning as a mutual journey. Yessica's willingness to engage in academic and personal growth conversations elevated not just my skills but also my confidence. Her mentorship set the bar for what educational support should look like, and I'm better both as a developer and thinker for having worked with her.

Moreover, Yessica's influence stretches beyond the classroom. She contributes to Coding Temple's culture of curiosity and excellence among instructors and students alike. Her support was felt not only during coursework but as I prepared for real-world challenges after the bootcamp. The encouragement, advice, and genuine care she showed have shaped my career and aspirations in profound ways.

If you're seeking an instructor, mentor, or collaborator with technical wisdom and a true investment in others' success, I couldn't recommend Yessica more highly. Her exceptional blend of mastery and human insight will elevate anyone fortunate enough to work with her.

Working with Yessica at Applica was excellent. As Yessica's project manager, I valued how she turned requirements into clear plans, kept delivery predictable, and partnered openly across the team. She brought strong full-stack skills, attention to detail, and a solutions mindset that made our releases smoother.

Yessica is the kind of person who is simply a joy to work with! I have enjoyed working with her every day at Coding Temple. She stands out as one of the most intelligent and inspiring professionals I've ever collaborated with.

Her exceptionalism shines through in her passion for teaching and mentoring. She has an incredible ability to make complex technical concepts engaging and accessible, ensuring that her students walk away with new insights every single day. Her enthusiasm for technology and software engineering has not only elevated her students but also enriched our entire team. Heck, she teaches me something new every week!

On a personal level, she is warm and friendly. She is an asset to any team, for sure!

Yessica has been a reliable partner for Tropical Year over the past few months. She's worked across a range of projects and tech stacks—our studio site, client builds, and internal tooling—and has handled the context-switching that comes with a busy agency without missing a beat. She's fast, communicative, and doesn't need a lot of hand-holding to get up to speed. She understands the work, asks the right questions, and delivers. On top of that, she's easy to work with—which goes a long way. We really enjoy working with and highly recommend her.

Yessica is one of my favorite instructors at Coding Temple! She is super knowledgeable, supportive, and patient, and creates a learning environment that is welcoming and unpretentious. She has taught me everything I know about React and TypeScript. She does everything she can to help a student grasp a concept and takes the time to explain things clearly. Her years of experience definitely come through and I am inspired by her every time I have the chance to be a part of one of her workshops!

Not only is Yessica a top-notch instructor, she is also an amazing coder with a strong teamwork mindset, a true asset to this industry.

I had the pleasure of working with Yessica during my time at Coding Temple, and she was an incredible support throughout my studying journey. From day one until graduation, Yessica was always there to provide guidance, encouragement, and resources to help me succeed. Her professionalism, positivity, and genuine care for students made a huge difference in my experience. I'm very grateful for all of her help, and I highly recommend Yessica for her dedication and commitment to student success.

I met Yessica at Coding Temple. We were partners in the Student Success department, where we managed to assist hundreds of students in their journey in the program. Yessica always proved to be a great professional by always suggesting and implementing initiatives to improve the students' experience and offer the best service possible. She was always willing to help students and her teammates.

Yessica was excellent IT support for our team. She took the time to teach others how to use the platform clearly and patiently, and she worked through every error until it was resolved. We could always count on her to troubleshoot issues thoroughly, and nothing got brushed aside.
My student mentor Yessica was always there to help me throughout my whole experience and I couldn't be more grateful to have such a caring mentor.

Yessica has been so crucial during my time at Coding Temple. Between helping me understand difficult parts of the curriculum and supporting me on a personal level during a period when I was dealt a blow that put me at the lowest point in my life, she has been there for me every step of the way, sharing her own experiences from similar moments and helping me navigate, with unparalleled consideration and compassion. The way she breaks down problems you may run into during the Software Engineering course makes it all feel easy to understand, and she teaches you tricks that aren’t even on the course. She’s honestly a lifesaver, and I don’t know what I’d do without her.

Yessica was extremely supportive and helpful throughout the entire journey. Yessica consistently went above and beyond to provide detailed feedback, answer questions, and encourage me through each module. Her patience and genuine care made a huge difference in my learning experience, and I'm incredibly grateful for her guidance.
